twitter_description: Iron Essence, a locked door, and a spiritual herb that only Han Li knows he raised. The quietest flex in mortal-stream xianxia.

lore_anchors.definition: A Magical Treasure material refined only by the Nascent Flame of a Core Formation cultivator. It dramatically boosts the power of ordinary magical tools if incorporated, making its appearance a major social event in any low-level auction.

The internal flame produced by a Core Formation cultivator, capable of refining materials like Iron Essence. Its presence is a mark of a cultivator who has reached a fundamentally higher tier of power.
A top-grade spiritual herb aged over a thousand years, used to refine pills that can break cultivation bottlenecks or greatly enhance magical power.

A narrative payoff in Mortal Stream fiction where the protagonist wins not through combat, but through superior preparation, resource management, and patience—often while others fight over what he already possesses.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did everyone get scared of the burly man after the Iron Essence was revealed?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because only a Core Formation cultivator’s Nascent Flame can produce Iron Essence. So the room realized he was either a Core Formation expert in disguise or had a Core Formation backer—either option made him too dangerous to bid against.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the secret shop lock the door?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It’s a standard Dark Forest security measure: keep everyone inside until the auction fully ends, preventing premature exits that could trigger ambushes or theft outside.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li feel proud at the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the millennium herb causing the bidding war was one he personally nurtured with the Heaven Vial. His quiet satisfaction comes from seeing his own secret work shake the room.
